name: cura-Fusion3 F410
start_gcode:
; Fusion3 F410 start code
M104 S0 ; shutdown heater and prepare to print
G21  ; set units to mm
G90  ; use absolute coordinates
T0  ; select tool 0
G92 E0.0  ; reset e count
M220 S100 ; reset speed multiplier
M140 S60  ; set bed temp and do not wait
G32  ; call to run bed.g
M190 S60 ; Set bed temperature and wait
M109 S210 ; set print head temperature and wait
; === pause for heating ===
; reset filament monitor
M42 P63 S0
G4 P100
G4 P50
M42 P63 S1
G1 X350 Y0
G1 Z10.0 F2000  ; move up
G1 E10.0 F500  ; prime extruder
G92 E0.0  ; reset e count
G1 X330 Y15 F9000  ; move back
G1 Z0.1 F1000  ; move down to begin wipe
G1 X150 E4.0 F6000  ; wipe print head (extrude material while we do this)
G92 E0.0  ; reset e count
end_gcode:
; Fusion3 F410 end code
G91  ;relative positioning
G1 E-5.00 F1000  ;retract 5mm of filament
G1 Z+1.00 X-20.0 Y+20.0 F10000  ;short quick move to disengage from print
G90  ;absolute positioning
G1 X0.0 Y350.0 F9000  ; move head to back left corner
G91  ; relative positioning
G1 E-5.00 F500  ;retract additional filament to prevent oozing
G90 ;absolute positioning
M104 S0  ;turn off hotend
M140 S0  ;turn off heatbed
; Reset filament monitor
M42 P63 S0
G4 P100
G4 P50
M42 P63 S1
G1 Z315 F1000 ;move print bed down to idle position
M106 S0  ; shut off blower
M84  ;motors off
M561  ;clear bed probe transformation
